item.title: Archery
item.description:
The skill beats luck - fortune favors the prepared.

Shooting is to study one’s own mind (observation, introspection, self-awareness). through practice and experience (strictly by doing, not reading or watching).

The ancient practice of knowing your self (as you really are, not as you think you are).

The ancient exercise in self-discipline, introspection and self-knowing (know thyself).

Each shot reveals what you [actually] are (to you).

Each shot reveals you as a living Buddha or a tense fool.
